body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and reduce the target's Fortitude by 1 against your next Prowess Action until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Pull the target 1 unit after the attack.
The Fortitude penalty also applies to your next Prowess Reaction against it before your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Opener
rider.html: After a hit, gain 1 additional Combo. Spend 1 Combo when the target next moves before your next turn to move 1 unit with it, keeping adjacent.
